_comment: One-shot quarterly mutation audit (v0.6.0 Phase 7.6). Mutates only the highest-risk directories -- guardrails and tool handlers -- where surviving mutants reveal genuine test gaps. Not wired into CI; run on demand: 'npx stryker run --config-file configs/stryker.config.json'.
_testFilesComment: Limit the test-runner to suites that actually exercise the mutated directories. The wider unit-test suite contains a small number of timing-sensitive checks (e.g. Orchestrator.test.ts asserts totalTimeMs > 0) that are flaky under Stryker's per-test sandbox; running them gates the dry-run unnecessarily and they cover code we are not mutating.
